errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are for every 5 years (1980, 1985, 1990, etc.), not for every year as stated in the description.
The y-axis range shown in the figure is from -25 to 225, not from 0 to 225. The label "Lower Risk" points to 0 and below, with a value "(25)" indicating -25.
The line representing Bulgaria is blue, not gray.
